title: Ross Springs Waterline Replacement
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF > FOREST SERVICE > ASHLEY NATIONAL FOREST
description:
This project includes the replacement of 4” asbestos cement pipe (abandoned in place) with 4” HDPE water main and associated valves and connections to laterals. 

 
	 The work includes;
	 
		 Installation of 4450 linear feet of 4” HDPE pipeline, most of which will be shallow bury or laid on cleared ground and covered with imported fill from a government source. 
		 Cover an additional 1150 linear feet of existing pipeline with imported fill from a government source. 
		 Installation of 2 combination air-vacuum valves with utility boxes. 
		 Installing associated valves, daylight drains, and pumpout drains; and connecting to existing lateral mains and services.
